summary: Implement Phase 1 Controller foundation, secure Core enrollment, inventory and monitoring. API impact: new contract for administrator sessions, inventory, enrollment/certificate lifecycle, authenticated agent reports and durable refresh operations.

guide.reason: New development-version setup, enrollment, health monitoring, certificate lifecycle and recovery workflows.

api.reason: Implement both ends of new versioned Controller/client and Core/Controller contracts, with OpenAPI and generated offline reference.

state.reason: Sites, administrator accounts, audit history, enrollment tokens and the Controller CA are the closed Controller-scoped exceptions; the pools and hosts tables are mirrors of enrolled hosts.
state.record: Controller SQLite (/var/lib/nex-controller/controller.db: sites, admins, audit, tokens, certificates) plus the Controller CA and identity keys in the same data directory; backed up and restored by the appliance recovery export (host-recovery export/restore in docs/guide/deploy-controller-appliance.md); pools/hosts rows are mirrors re-adopted from host enrollment and reports.

verification.method: Focused Go race tests, API contract/reference and source-bundle checks, UI typecheck/build, disposable process/browser walkthroughs and independent review; actual outcomes and limits are recorded in Phase 1 QA evidence.
